title: Senate passes 2027 OP budget in two minutes
summary: The new recommended appropriation for the Office of the President is P10.83 billion

blocks.text: PALACE. Malacañang Palace riverside facade in 2013.
The new recommended appropriation for the Office of the President is P10.83 billion
MANILA. Philippines – The Senate on Tuesday, November 24, swiftly approved the P10 billion proposed budget of the Office of the President (OP) for 2027 in just two minutes.
Senator JV Ejercito, sponsor of the budget, noted during the plenary deliberations the new recommended appropriation for the OP is now P10.83 billion.

“Out of courtesy, and historically, we give due courtesy to the budgets of the Office of the President and Office of the Vice President,” Senate Majority Floor Leader Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri said in moving for the passage of the proposed budget.
Senate President Pro-Tempore Vicente “Tito” Sotto III approved the motion sans objections.
The OP initially sought P10.158 billion, roughly one-third of its current 2026 budget and over two-thirds of its 2025 budget, in the 2027 National Expenditure Program (NEP).

Executive Secretary Ralph Recto previously said that the staggering budget cut was because the Philippines’ 2026 chairmanship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) was lodged under the OP and is broken down based on the various agencies involved in the preparations related to hosting different meetings and the summits under the regional grouping.

“We’re asking for less while remaining fully prepared to do more. We believe this amount is sufficient for the Presidency to meet the exacting demands of leading the nation at a time of overlapping domestic and external challenges,” Recto said during the OP’s budget briefing before the House committee on appropriations on September 1. – Rappler.com
